text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running in the Satsuki Sho, Ines 
Fujin became more conscious of others, and 
being conscious of them made her desire 
victory all the more fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Responding to those feelings, the Trainer 
promised to lead her to victory in the 
race every Umamusume dreams of, the 
Japanese Derby, as the first favorite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin, too, strongly wishes to win 
and live up to her Trainer's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It came from a deep sense of gratitude 
toward them for granting all of her 
selfish requests— from letting her keep 
her part-time job to aiming for the Derby.
